changedBehavior: People editors offer searchable categorized face and upper-body emoji portraits with optional gender and two-tone variants, preserve saved identifiers, preview the actual short name beside the portrait, and render the portrait consistently in People and Devices surfaces. Room icons are unchanged.
expectedAssertions: Manager offers one primary choice with variants off and four gender-by-tone combinations with variants on; search, category and variant filtering never replace a selected icon.
Keyboard selection and Escape close the picker and return focus; empty search results are explicit; the preview follows the full existing Short name without adding a letter field.
An emoji choice survives save, reopen and application restart; cancellation and failed saves preserve the previous saved icon or current editor draft respectively.
Existing Fluent icon IDs, null IDs and unknown IDs round-trip unchanged; unsupported newer Windows sequences are not offered on older Windows builds.
People lists, person details and separate or combined Devices person cells render the saved portrait beside the existing short name without changing assignment, sorting or room behavior.
UI-review selection includes the new picker and preview views and all consumers of the shared portrait catalog and renderer.
